stories.title: U.S. ambassador calls settler siege of Palestinian homes a 'horrific act of terror'
stories.summary: The U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee condemned the actions of Jewish settlers who are besieging the home of an American Palestinian family in the Israeli-occupied West Bank.
